newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AUSTRIAN ECONOMY MISSION TO VISIT VILNIUS.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRIAN ECONOMY MISSION TO VISIT VILNIUS.

text.p: Lithuania's finance ministry said on Tuesday that an Austrian economic delegation will arrive in Lithuania on June 5 for a two-day visit.
The finance ministry said in a statement that around 30 Austrian companies will be represented in the mission.
They are mostly interested interested in establishing trade contacts in the Baltic countries, the statement said.
The delegation will be headed by Heinrich Baminger, the director of the Nordic Europe department of the Austrian Economy chamber, the statement said.
